status_note: RuleCollapseConstants full-opcode port (lease RULE-PORT-COLLAPSECONSTANTS-0001, RULE_GAPS_2026-08-22.md §2 P1). applyOp driven directly on synthetic ops in a real BfdArchitecture Funcdata; observations cover every collapsible opcode class, the opMarkNoCollapse error paths, the isCollapsible guards, and the markedInput equate propagation. oplist normalized to live opcodes (Ghidra pushes 0..73 incl. dead slots 0/45 which no PcodeOp can carry — opcodes.hh:37/92).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: collapse(bool &markedInput) pass-back flag -> ruleaction.cc:3863-3875 markedInput gates collapseConstantSymbol before inputs are unlinked; op/data are reference-mutated (newVarnode, opRemoveInput i=numInput()-1..1, opSetInput(vn,0), opSetOpcode COPY).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: for(i=op->numInput()-1;i>0;--i) opRemoveInput(op,i) — inputs removed last-to-first, slot 0 kept; cases execute in the listed order; both applyOp invocations (first/second) per case.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: markedInput initialized false per applyOp (ruleaction.cc:3863), set true only by getIn(0)/getIn(1) SymbolEntry presence inside collapse (op.cc:455-457/463-465), never reset mid-apply.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sort keys; dispatch order is isCollapsible -> eval-type switch (unary uses in0 only; binary checks in1 symbol too; ternary/special throw) -> collapseConstantSymbol copyVn selection switch (SUBPIECE offset!=0 reject; commutative family in0-then-in1).

analysis_options: none: direct RuleCollapseConstants/PcodeOp::collapse harness; no decompilation pipeline options

oplist_all_opcodes.covers: action.cc:706-713 base getOpList = every opcode; live projection 72 == Rugra get_opcodes()

int_div_rem_signed_family.covers: INT_SDIV/SREM trunc-toward-zero + DIV/REM + zero-divisor error paths (opbehavior.cc:499-539)

piece_subpiece_family.covers: PIECE concat + SUBPIECE truncation at byte offsets (opbehavior.cc:752-766)

comparison_carry_family.covers: INT_EQUAL..SBORROW incl. signed compare and carry bit tricks (opbehavior.cc:183-360)

float_family_4_8.covers: FLOAT_EQUAL..ROUND/INT2FLOAT/FLOAT2FLOAT/TRUNC at 4/8 bytes via TypeOp evaluate bridge (opbehavior.cc:569-750)

error_paths_nocollapse.covers: div-by-zero, ternary INSERT 'Invalid constant collapse', missing 2-byte float format -> opMarkNoCollapse (ruleaction.cc:3867-3870)

guards.covers: isCollapsible early-outs: non-constant input, PTRSUB nocollapse opflag, >8-byte output (op.cc:115-125)

symbol_propagation.covers: markedInput -> collapseConstantSymbol propagate (INT_ADD in0) + SUBPIECE offset!=0 rejection (op.cc:503-540)

equate_isvalueclose_strictness.covers: Ghidra copySymbolIfValid requires dynamic_cast<EquateSymbol*> AND EquateSymbol::isValueClose (varnode.cc:510-522, database.cc:640-659); Rugra copy_symbol_if_valid approximates as 'mapentry + both constants' (varnode.rs). Covered case uses exact-equality equate where both agree; the not-close rejection branch is untested by this fixture.

float_int2float_signedness.covers: Ghidra FloatFormat::opInt2Float sign-extends the integer from sizein (float.cc:611-617); Rugra float_emulate.rs op_int2float treats the input as unsigned. Covered case uses 7 (positive, agrees); negative inputs are untested.

mixed_size_sright_mask.covers: Ghidra OpBehaviorIntSright returns an unmasked result when sizein>sizeout (opbehavior.cc:454-472) while Rugra's free-function table masks to size_out; SLEIGH never emits mixed-size shifts, so the divergence is unobservable in covered cases and untested here.

branches.detail: Ghidra copySymbolIfValid requires dynamic_cast<EquateSymbol*> AND EquateSymbol::isValueClose (varnode.cc:510-522, database.cc:640-659); Rugra copy_symbol_if_valid approximates as 'mapentry + both constants' (varnode.rs). Covered case uses exact-equality equate where both agree; the not-close rejection branch is untested by this fixture.

Ghidra FloatFormat::opInt2Float sign-extends the integer from sizein (float.cc:611-617); Rugra float_emulate.rs op_int2float treats the input as unsigned. Covered case uses 7 (positive, agrees); negative inputs are untested.

Ghidra OpBehaviorIntSright returns an unmasked result when sizein>sizeout (opbehavior.cc:454-472) while Rugra's free-function table masks to size_out; SLEIGH never emits mixed-size shifts, so the divergence is unobservable in covered cases and untested here.
